item.title: LAMÉ HAVE IT
item.description: Lanvin Lamé skirt I'm not sure if I want to unwrap it, wear it, or frame it and hang it on my wall. I'm also not sure if I want to pair it with flip flops and a tank top or glam it up with cage pumps, Marilyn Monroe jewels and a leopard coat. I'd even love it in the winter with tights and a cashmere sweater and black flats. Point is, this girl's got range and I'm feeling a bit like Sybil. xoxo Foil girl, I mean Lamé girl, I mean Sparkle Girl!
